subtitle: Design Project / Introduction

educationalGoal:
-To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions.
-To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
-To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events.
-To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
-To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice:
In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basic “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing→ visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
Data-handling skills are extremely important to correctly understand results. For this purpose, it is necessary to acquire highly accurate experimental techniques. In addition, it is important to have basic academic skills in specialized fields.
PBL is an effective means for enhancing educational effects. It is necessary to understand the contents of PBL well.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of basic life science (Biochemistry, Microbiology, Enzymology, Molecular biology, Organic chemistry).
Highly accurate experimental techniques.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basic “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing→ visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
Data-handling skills are extremely important to correctly understand results. For this purpose, it is necessary to acquire highly accurate experimental techniques. In addition, it is important to have basic academic skills in specialized fields.
PBL is an effective means for enhancing educational effects. It is necessary to understand the contents of PBL well.
